svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Kubernetes web workload
svg.desc: Kubernetes web workload. 11 components in 2 groups. Connections: Users to Ingress (HTTPS); Ingress to Service; Service to Pods; HorizontalPodAutoscaler to Deployment (scales); Deployment to ReplicaSet; ReplicaSet to Pods; Pods to ConfigMap; Pods to Secret; Pods to PersistentVolumeClaim; PersistentVolumeClaim to PersistentVolume (bound).

text.tspan: Traffic reaches the pods through an Ingress and a Service; a Deployment creates them, an autoscaler scales it, and they use a ConfigMap, a Secret and a volume claim
